quiz.text: Give two differences between mitosis and meiosis.
quiz.answer: Mitosis has 1 division and makes 2 genetically identical diploid (2n = 46) cells for growth and repair. Meiosis has 2 divisions and makes 4 genetically unique haploid (n = 23) gametes, with variation from crossing over (Prophase I) and independent assortment (Metaphase I).

quiz.text: Describe the hormone events that lead to ovulation around Day 14 of the menstrual cycle.
quiz.answer: The hypothalamus releases GnRH, so the anterior pituitary releases FSH and LH. FSH makes follicles mature and secrete rising estrogen. Near Day 14 high estrogen triggers an LH surge, which makes the dominant follicle rupture and release the egg.
